about: Every place the mod touches the game. Line numbers are from the reference source; re-check them against the installed game version.

columns.kind: hook_safe (runs after, can't change result) / hook (wraps the call) / update / listener

rows.purpose: Every enemy (host spawn and client husk) and every placed banner passes here; queue the unit to be skinned next frame once its breed data is set.
Pooled enemies are made visible again when reused; hide the original model again.
Delete our skin when its enemy is removed.
Apply queued skins one frame after spawn.
Every hero's third-person mesh (yours and other players') is spawned here; skin it if a player_skins row matches the career.
Your first-person arms are spawned here; skin them if a player_skins row matches the career.
Weapons are linked to hands and holsters here; the node_linking table identifies the weapon (weapon_skins).

rows.source: engine function, called from Lua by the game to show and hide units
rows.purpose: Hosts wearing a skin stay hidden; the visibility the game asks for goes to the skin instead (first/third person switches, hidden weapons, frozen enemies).
